level.title: Korean B2+ — Contract and negotiation
goals: Read a contract clause and name what it requires or forbids
Trade a concession for a condition instead of giving it away
Write the one sentence both sides can sign

lessons.title: 조항을 확인해요
lessons.learn: A clause states what must be done: 다음 달까지 납품하도록 명시되어 있습니다. The requirement takes -도록, and 명시하다 is what the document does.

grammar.title: What a clause requires
grammar.pattern: 납품하도록 명시되어 있습니다 · 기한은 다음 달입니다 · 갱신은 양쪽 동의가 필요합니다
grammar.explain: -도록 states what the clause requires of you, and it pairs with the passive 명시되어 있다, because the document is what specifies. A requirement that needs agreement takes 이/가 필요하다.

examples.en: It is specified that delivery is due by next month.
Renewal requires the agreement of both sides.
If the deadline is passed there is a penalty.

mistakes.why: A requirement in a document takes -도록 with the passive 명시되어 있다.
The thing required takes 이/가: 동의가 필요하다.

dialogue.en: Could we check this clause together?

dialogue.t: 네, 다음 달까지 납품하도록 명시되어 있습니다.
dialogue.r: ne, daeum dal-kkaji napumhadodorok myeongsidoeeo itseumnida.
dialogue.en: Yes, it specifies delivery by next month.
What happens if the deadline is missed?

dialogue.t: 위약금이 있고, 갱신도 양쪽 동의가 필요합니다.
dialogue.r: wiyakgeum-i itgo, gaengsindo yangjjok dong-ui-ga piryohamnida.
dialogue.en: There is a penalty, and renewal also needs both sides to agree.

lessons.title: 기한과 지연
lessons.learn: Delay is admitted and dated: 이 주 지연될 수 있습니다. -ㄹ 경우에는 covers the conditional case, and 연장 is the extension you ask for in writing.

grammar.title: Delay and extension
grammar.pattern: 이 주 지연될 수 있습니다 · 지연될 경우에는 통보합니다 · 기한을 연장해 주십시오
grammar.explain: Possibility of delay takes -(으)ㄹ 수 있다; the conditional case takes -ㄹ 경우에는. The extension is requested in writing, and the notice obligation is stated with 통보하다.

examples.t: 납품이 이 주 지연될 수 있습니다.
examples.r: napum-i i ju jiyeondoel su itseumnida.
examples.en: Delivery may be delayed by a week.
If it is delayed I will give notice at once.
Please extend the deadline by a week.

mistakes.why: 경우 already carries the case; 때 is not stacked on it.
One request form per sentence.

dialogue.en: The delivery looks like being late.
How long is the delay?

dialogue.t: 일주일쯤 지연될 수 있습니다. 지연될 경우에는 바로 통보하겠습니다.
dialogue.r: iljuil-jjeum jiyeondoel su itseumnida. jiyeondoel gyeong-u-eneun baro tongbohagetseumnida.
dialogue.en: It may be delayed by about a week. If so, I will notify you at once.

dialogue.t: 그럼 기한을 일주일 연장해 주십시오. 문서로 부탁드립니다.
dialogue.r: geureom gihan-eul iljuil yeonjanghae jusipsio. munjoseo butakdeurimnida.

lessons.title: 위험을 분담해요
lessons.learn: Risk is divided in the clause itself: 위험은 양쪽이 나누어 부담합니다. The condition that pairs a duty with its limit takes -는 조건으로.

grammar.title: Splitting a risk
grammar.pattern: 위험은 양쪽이 나누어 부담합니다 · 보상 한도는 계약 금액의 십 퍼센트입니다 · 그 조건으로
grammar.explain: A duty and its limit are joined with -는 조건으로: 책임을 지는 조건으로 한도를 정합니다. 부담하다 takes the burden as its object, and 한도 is what caps the compensation.

examples.en: Each side bears part of the risk.

examples.t: 보상 한도는 계약 금액의 십 퍼센트입니다.
examples.r: bosang hando-neun gyeyak geumaeg-ui sip peosenteu-imnida.
examples.en: The compensation ceiling is ten percent of the contract value.
I will accept responsibility on condition that a ceiling is set.

mistakes.why: The risk is the topic; 양쪽 is the subject that bears it.
한도 is what is being capped, so it heads the phrase.

dialogue.en: How is the risk divided?

dialogue.t: 양쪽이 나누어 부담하고, 보상 한도는 계약 금액의 십 퍼센트입니다.
dialogue.r: yangjjok-i nanueo budamhago, bosang hando-neun gyeyak geumaeg-ui sip peosenteu-imnida.
dialogue.en: Both sides share it, and the compensation ceiling is ten percent of the contract value.
I will accept responsibility on condition that a ceiling is set.
We will put it into the clause that way.

lessons.title: 조건부로 합의해요
lessons.learn: A conditional agreement is one sentence: 이 조건이 지켜지면 합의하겠습니다. 검토 후에 확정하겠습니다 buys the time without refusing.

grammar.title: Agreeing with a condition
grammar.pattern: 이 조건이 지켜지면 합의하겠습니다 · 검토 후에 확정하겠습니다 · 잠정 합의입니다
grammar.explain: A condition that must hold takes -면 with the passive 지켜지다: if it is kept. 검토 후에 puts the review before the decision, and 잠정 marks the agreement as provisional.

examples.en: If this condition is kept, I will agree.
I will finalise it after review.
For now let us leave it as a provisional agreement.

mistakes.why: The condition is what gets kept, so the passive 지켜지다 is used.
후에 follows the noun 검토, and it comes before the decision.

grammar.title: Setting out two positions

lessons.learn: A mediation proposal gives each side something it named: 비용은 그대로 두고 범위를 줄이도록 반영하겠습니다. The form -도록 반영하다 turns a demand into a draft.

grammar.title: Drafting a mediation proposal
grammar.pattern: 비용은 그대로 두고 범위를 줄이도록 반영하겠습니다 · 양쪽 요구를 절충했습니다

The compromise modifies the proposal: 절충한 안.

lessons.title: 합의문을 씁니다
lessons.learn: The closing sentence of an agreement is written in a flat, impersonal register: 본 계약은 서명한 날로부터 발효한다. -ㄴ 것으로 한다 fixes what was agreed without naming anybody.

grammar.title: Writing the agreement
grammar.pattern: 서명한 날로부터 발효한다 · 위 내용을 명기한다 · 양쪽이 확인한 것으로 한다
grammar.explain: Agreements are written in the plain -ㄴ다/-한다 register, with -ㄴ 것으로 한다 for what is fixed: 확인한 것으로 한다, it is deemed confirmed. 날로부터 marks the day something takes effect.

examples.en: This agreement takes effect from the day of signature.
The above is stated in the clause.
It is deemed confirmed by both sides.

mistakes.why: One register per agreement: the plain -ㄴ다 form throughout.
The finalising frame attaches to the modifier form 확인한.

culture.text: Korean business agreements are written down more than the Korean proverb about words would suggest. A 계약서 is read clause by clause, and the 도장 — the personal seal — still carries more weight than a signature in many offices, though both are common. What negotiators guard is not the headline number but the 기한, because a missed date triggers 위약금 and reopens everything else. Mediation is therefore normal rather than exceptional, and 잠정 합의, a provisional agreement, is a respectable outcome rather than a failure.

reading.text: 지난주에 계약 협상을 했습니다. 처음에는 비용 때문에 양쪽이 맞서서 회의가 두 시간 걸렸습니다. 중재자가 쟁점을 세 가지로 정리했습니다. 그리고 나서 차이를 좁혔습니다. 우리는 비용을 그대로 두고 범위를 줄이는 대신에 기한을 일주일 늘렸습니다. 합의문에는 그 내용을 조항에 명기했습니다. 발효일은 서명한 날로 정했습니다. 아직 잠정 합의지만 양쪽이 같은 문서를 가지고 있습니다.
reading.gloss: Last week we negotiated a contract. At first the two sides were opposed over cost and the meeting took two hours. The mediator laid out the points at issue as three. Then we narrowed the gap. We kept the cost as it was, reduced the scope and in exchange extended the deadline by a week. The agreement states that in the clause. The effective date is set as the day of signature. It is still a provisional agreement, but both sides hold the same document.

task.title: Negotiate a contract you would sign
task.instructions: Write a six-line negotiation: your priority, one concession with -는 대신에, one line you will not cross with 양보할 수 없습니다, two alternatives counted with 가지, and a closing conditional agreement with 지켜지면. Then write the one sentence of the 합의문 that fixes what you agreed.
